leadText:
Keith (Japanese: キクマ Kikuma) is a character of the day who appeared in The Evolutionary War!.

Keith lives on Island B, one of the A-B-C Islands. He attends school over on Island A. Unlike many on Island B, he prefers over . Because of this, he had a rivalry with Nancy from Island C, who prefers Gorebyss.

He and joined Professor Birch's visits to Islands C and B to discover more about and its branched Evolution. After Birch learned that the islands' waters contained Deep Sea Scale or Deep Sea Tooth extract, Keith tagged along again. On Island C Nancy located a Deep Sea Tooth and gave it to Keith. Likewise, Keith ended up finding a Deep Sea Scale on Island B and gave it to Nancy, and she used it to evolve her Clamperl into her desired Gorebyss.

When came by and tried to steal his and Nancy's Pokémon, freed the Pokémon with . Afterwards, they worked together to defeat Team Rocket's mecha, sending them blasting off. As a result, Keith and Nancy were finally able to end their rivalry with each other and waved goodbye to and .
